svg.aria-label: Nine masks over one vocabulary of 105 interpretation flags
svg.text: Nine masks over one vocabulary — GBIF occurrence index, year=2025, read 2026-08-31
86,396,340 records · 9 values of dwc:basisOfRecord · 105 interpretation flags
A · WHICH NORMS REACH THIS KIND OF THING
Same 105 cells, same 105 positions, in every grid. Ink where that box's records carry that flag; darker with a larger share (log). An empty ring is a flag no record in the window carries.
B · THE SAME 105 CELLS, AGAINST THE INSTITUTION'S OWN FLAG REFERENCE
Solid: described and fired. Outlined: described, fired on no record in the window. Cross: not described on the reference page, and fired. Empty ring: neither.
64 described and firing · 16 described and never firing · 5 undescribed and firing (36 records in 86,396,340) · 20 neither
C · THE WINDOW ITSELF, AT TRUE WIDTH
Each segment is one box, its width the share of records it holds. Dark: carries at least one flag. Red: carries none of the 105.
27.63 % of the window carries no flag at all — and 99.92 % of that un-normed remainder is in one branch.
Gap between the six eligible branches: 29.05 points. With the highest and lowest dropped: 1.00.
